form.label: Claude Enterprise - Usage & Spend Analytics
form.description: Adoption, tokenomics, billing, and spend-limit governance. Requires the Analytics Reports input. Scope the claude_index macro to your Claude index if needed.

search.query: `claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_usage" OR sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_cost" | stats count by email | sort email
`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:*" | head 1 | stats count

panel.title: No analytics data in the selected time range

html.p: These panels read the anthropic:analytics:* sourcetypes, which come from the Analytics Reports input. Anthropic finalizes analytics with a ~3 day lag, so short windows such as Last 24 hours are often empty by design - try Last 7 or 30 days first. If widening the range does not help:

ol.li: Make sure your API key includes the read:analytics scope (and read:spend_limits for the spend-limit panels). If one key carries all scopes, entering it as the Compliance key on Configuration > Account is enough - the Analytics key field can stay blank and the compliance key is reused. Otherwise add a dedicated key with those scopes in the Analytics API key field.
On Inputs, create an Analytics Reports input for that account (interval 86400 recommended).
Anthropic finalizes analytics with a ~3 day lag, so the newest data point will be about 3 days old. Widen the time range if needed.
If you ingest into a dedicated index, update the claude_index macro (Settings > Advanced search > Search macros).

html.p: Errors from the input are logged in index=_internal source=*anthropic_claude*. This message disappears automatically once analytics events are indexed.

search.query: `claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:summary" | sort - _time | head 1 | fields weekly_active_user_count
`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:summary" | sort - _time | head 1 | fields daily_active_user_count

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:summary" | sort - _time | head 1 | eval stickiness=if(weekly_active_user_count>0, round(100*daily_active_user_count/weekly_active_user_count,1), null()) | fields stickiness
`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:cost" | `claude_latest_load` | eval cost_usd=coalesce(tonumber(amount)/100, total_cost_usd) | stats sum(cost_usd) AS total | eval total=round(total, 2)

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:usage" | `claude_latest_load` | eval tokens=coalesce(output_tokens,0)+coalesce(uncached_input_tokens,0)+coalesce(cache_read_input_tokens,0)+coalesce('cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens',0)+coalesce('cache_creation.ephemeral_5m_input_tokens',0)+coalesce(cache_creation_input_tokens,0) | stats sum(tokens) AS total_tokens
`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:summary" | timechart max(daily_active_user_count) AS Daily max(weekly_active_user_count) AS Weekly
`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:summary" | timechart max(daily_adoption_rate) AS Daily max(monthly_adoption_rate) AS Monthly

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:usage" | `claude_latest_load` | eval cache_creation_tokens=coalesce('cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens',0)+coalesce('cache_creation.ephemeral_5m_input_tokens',0)+coalesce(cache_creation_input_tokens,0) | timechart sum(output_tokens) AS "Output" sum(uncached_input_tokens) AS "Uncached Input" sum(cache_read_input_tokens) AS "Cache Read" sum(cache_creation_tokens) AS "Cache Creation"

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:usage" | `claude_latest_load` | stats sum(cache_read_input_tokens) AS cached sum(uncached_input_tokens) AS uncached | eval hit_rate=if((coalesce(cached,0)+coalesce(uncached,0))>0, round(100*coalesce(cached,0)/(coalesce(cached,0)+coalesce(uncached,0)),1), null()) | fields hit_rate

single.option: cache reads vs. uncached input tokens

search.query: `claude_index` (sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:cost" OR sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:usage") | `claude_latest_load` | eval cost_usd=if(sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:cost", coalesce(tonumber(amount)/100, total_cost_usd), null()) | eval tokens=if(sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:usage", coalesce(output_tokens,0)+coalesce(uncached_input_tokens,0)+coalesce(cache_read_input_tokens,0), null()) | stats sum(cost_usd) AS cost sum(tokens) AS tokens | eval cost_per_mtok=if(tokens>0, round(1000000*cost/tokens, 2), null()) | fields cost_per_mtok

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:cost" | `claude_latest_load` | eval cost_usd=coalesce(tonumber(amount)/100, total_cost_usd) | eval product_label=case(product="claude_code", "Claude Code", product="cowork", "Cowork", product="office_agent", "Office Agent", product="chat", "Claude.ai", isnotnull(product), product, 1=1, "Other") | timechart sum(cost_usd) AS spend by product_label

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:usage" | `claude_latest_load` | eval product_label=case(product="claude_code", "Claude Code", product="cowork", "Cowork", product="office_agent", "Office Agent", product="chat", "Claude.ai", isnotnull(product), product, 1=1, "Other") | eval tokens=coalesce(output_tokens,0)+coalesce(uncached_input_tokens,0)+coalesce(cache_read_input_tokens,0) | stats sum(tokens) AS tokens by product_label
`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:cost" | `claude_latest_load` | eval cost_usd=coalesce(tonumber(amount)/100, total_cost_usd) | timechart sum(cost_usd) AS spend by model

`claude_index` (sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:cost" OR sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:usage") model=* | `claude_latest_load` | eval cost_usd=if(sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:cost", coalesce(tonumber(amount)/100, total_cost_usd), null()) | eval tokens=if(sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:usage", coalesce(output_tokens,0)+coalesce(uncached_input_tokens,0)+coalesce(cache_read_input_tokens,0), null()) | stats sum(cost_usd) AS cost sum(tokens) AS tokens by model | where tokens>0 AND cost>0 | eval cost_per_mtok=round(1000000*cost/tokens, 2) | sort - cost_per_mtok | fields model, cost_per_mtok

panel.title: Top 20 Users by Cost (USD) - click a user to drill down

search.query: `claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_cost" (("$user$"="*") OR email="$user$") | `claude_latest_load` | eval cost_usd=coalesce(tonumber(amount)/100, total_cost_usd) | stats sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd values(model) AS models values(product) AS products by email | eval cost_usd=round(cost_usd, 2) | sort - cost_usd | head 20 | rename email AS user, cost_usd AS "cost (USD)"

panel.title: Top 20 Users by Tokens - click a user to drill down

search.query: `claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_usage" (("$user$"="*") OR email="$user$") | `claude_latest_load` | stats sum(output_tokens) AS output_tokens sum(uncached_input_tokens) AS input_tokens by email | eval total_tokens=coalesce(output_tokens,0)+coalesce(input_tokens,0) | sort - total_tokens | head 20 | table email, output_tokens, input_tokens, total_tokens
`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:spend_limit_request" status="pending" | stats count
`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_cost" | stats count AS total count(eval(isnotnull(model))) AS attributed

panel.title: User-by-model and user-by-product panels need re-collected data

html.p: The panels below show only per-user rows that carry model and product attribution - there is no model/product data for the selected range yet. The Analytics Reports input re-collects the last 90 days automatically on its first run after upgrading; disable and re-enable the input on the Inputs page to run it now, wait a few minutes, then refresh. If this notice persists afterwards, check index=_internal source=*anthropic_claude* WARNING - the input logs a warning when the API refuses grouped collection. This notice disappears once attributed data is indexed.

panel.title: Who Used Which Model - Spend Matrix (USD)

search.query: `claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_cost" model=* (("$user$"="*") OR email="$user$") | `claude_latest_load` | eval cost_usd=coalesce(tonumber(amount)/100, total_cost_usd) | stats sum(cost_usd) AS spend by email, model | eval spend=round(spend, 2) | xyseries email model spend | addtotals fieldname=total_usd | sort - total_usd | rename email AS user

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_cost" model=* (("$user$"="*") OR email="$user$") | `claude_latest_load` | eval cost_usd=coalesce(tonumber(amount)/100, total_cost_usd) | chart sum(cost_usd) AS spend over email by model | addtotals fieldname=_total | sort - _total | fields - _total | head 20

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_usage" product=* (("$user$"="*") OR email="$user$") | `claude_latest_load` | eval tokens=coalesce(output_tokens,0)+coalesce(uncached_input_tokens,0)+coalesce(cache_read_input_tokens,0) | eval product_label=case(product="claude_code", "Claude Code", product="cowork", "Cowork", product="office_agent", "Office Agent", product="chat", "Claude.ai", isnotnull(product), product, 1=1, "Unattributed") | chart sum(tokens) AS tokens over email by product_label | addtotals fieldname=_total | sort - _total | fields - _total | head 20

panel.title: Selected User: Model Mix by Spend (USD)

search.query: `claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_cost" model=* (("$user$"="*") OR email="$user$") | `claude_latest_load` | eval cost_usd=coalesce(tonumber(amount)/100, total_cost_usd) | stats sum(cost_usd) AS spend by model | eval spend=round(spend, 2) | sort - spend

panel.title: Selected User: Product Mix by Tokens

search.query: `claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_usage" product=* (("$user$"="*") OR email="$user$") | `claude_latest_load` | eval tokens=coalesce(output_tokens,0)+coalesce(uncached_input_tokens,0)+coalesce(cache_read_input_tokens,0) | eval product_label=case(product="claude_code", "Claude Code", product="cowork", "Cowork", product="office_agent", "Office Agent", product="chat", "Claude.ai", isnotnull(product), product, 1=1, "Unattributed") | stats sum(tokens) AS tokens by product_label | sort - tokens

panel.title: Selected User: Daily Spend by Product (USD)

search.query: `claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_cost" product=* (("$user$"="*") OR email="$user$") | `claude_latest_load` | eval cost_usd=coalesce(tonumber(amount)/100, total_cost_usd) | eval product_label=case(product="claude_code", "Claude Code", product="cowork", "Cowork", product="office_agent", "Office Agent", product="chat", "Claude.ai", isnotnull(product), product, 1=1, "Unattributed") | timechart span=1d sum(cost_usd) AS spend by product_label

panel.title: Selected User: Daily Requests by Product (where time is spent)

search.query: `claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_usage" product=* (("$user$"="*") OR email="$user$") | `claude_latest_load` | eval product_label=case(product="claude_code", "Claude Code", product="cowork", "Cowork", product="office_agent", "Office Agent", product="chat", "Claude.ai", isnotnull(product), product, 1=1, "Unattributed") | timechart span=1d sum(requests) AS requests by product_label

panel.title: Selected User: Daily Tokens by Model

search.query: `claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_usage" model=* (("$user$"="*") OR email="$user$") | `claude_latest_load` | eval tokens=coalesce(output_tokens,0)+coalesce(uncached_input_tokens,0)+coalesce(cache_read_input_tokens,0) | timechart span=1d sum(tokens) AS tokens by model

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_cost" | `claude_latest_load` | eval cost_usd=coalesce(tonumber(amount)/100, total_cost_usd) | stats sum(cost_usd) AS user_spend by email | eventstats sum(user_spend) AS org_spend | sort - user_spend | head 5 | stats sum(user_spend) AS top5_spend max(org_spend) AS org_spend | eval concentration_pct=if(org_spend>0, round(100*top5_spend/org_spend,1), null()) | fields concentration_pct

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:spend_limit" | eval period_spend_usd=coalesce(tonumber(period_to_date_spend)/100, period_spend_usd) | eval spend_limit_usd=coalesce(tonumber(amount)/100, spend_limit_usd) | eval utilization_pct=case(spend_limit_usd>0, round(100*period_spend_usd/spend_limit_usd,1), isnotnull(utilization_pct), utilization_pct) | stats latest(period_spend_usd) AS period_spend_usd by email | stats sum(period_spend_usd) AS total | eval total=round(total, 2)

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:spend_limit" | eval period_spend_usd=coalesce(tonumber(period_to_date_spend)/100, period_spend_usd) | eval spend_limit_usd=coalesce(tonumber(amount)/100, spend_limit_usd) | eval utilization_pct=case(spend_limit_usd>0, round(100*period_spend_usd/spend_limit_usd,1), isnotnull(utilization_pct), utilization_pct) | stats latest(utilization_pct) AS utilization_pct by email | where utilization_pct>=80 | stats dc(email) AS users

panel.title: Spend vs. Limit by User (Latest Snapshot)

search.query: `claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:spend_limit" (("$user$"="*") OR email="$user$") | eval period_spend_usd=coalesce(tonumber(period_to_date_spend)/100, period_spend_usd) | eval spend_limit_usd=coalesce(tonumber(amount)/100, spend_limit_usd) | eval utilization_pct=case(spend_limit_usd>0, round(100*period_spend_usd/spend_limit_usd,1), isnotnull(utilization_pct), utilization_pct) | stats latest(user_name) AS name latest(period_spend_usd) AS period_spend_usd latest(spend_limit_usd) AS spend_limit_usd latest(utilization_pct) AS utilization_pct latest(limit_source_type) AS limit_source by email | eval period_spend_usd=round(period_spend_usd, 2), spend_limit_usd=round(spend_limit_usd, 2) | sort - period_spend_usd | rename period_spend_usd AS "spend (USD)", spend_limit_usd AS "limit (USD)", utilization_pct AS "utilization (%)"

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:spend_limit_request" status="pending" (("$user$"="*") OR email="$user$") | eval request_spend_limit_usd=coalesce(tonumber(request_spend_limit_cents)/100, request_spend_limit_usd) | eval request_period_spend_usd=coalesce(tonumber(request_period_spend_cents)/100, request_period_spend_usd) | stats latest(_time) AS _time latest(request_spend_limit_usd) AS requested_limit_usd latest(request_period_spend_usd) AS period_spend_usd by email | eval requested_limit_usd=round(requested_limit_usd, 2), period_spend_usd=round(period_spend_usd, 2) | sort - _time

panel.title: Claude Code Productivity by User (sessions, commits, PRs, lines of code, tool acceptance)

search.query: `claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_activity" (("$user$"="*") OR email="$user$") | `claude_latest_load` | stats sum('claude_code_metrics.core_metrics.distinct_session_count') AS sessions sum('claude_code_metrics.core_metrics.commit_count') AS commits sum('claude_code_metrics.core_metrics.pull_request_count') AS pull_requests sum('claude_code_metrics.core_metrics.lines_of_code.added_count') AS loc_added sum('claude_code_metrics.core_metrics.lines_of_code.removed_count') AS loc_removed sum('claude_code_metrics.tool_actions.edit_tool.accepted_count') AS a1 sum('claude_code_metrics.tool_actions.multi_edit_tool.accepted_count') AS a2 sum('claude_code_metrics.tool_actions.notebook_edit_tool.accepted_count') AS a3 sum('claude_code_metrics.tool_actions.write_tool.accepted_count') AS a4 sum('claude_code_metrics.tool_actions.edit_tool.rejected_count') AS r1 sum('claude_code_metrics.tool_actions.multi_edit_tool.rejected_count') AS r2 sum('claude_code_metrics.tool_actions.notebook_edit_tool.rejected_count') AS r3 sum('claude_code_metrics.tool_actions.write_tool.rejected_count') AS r4 by email | eval tools_accepted=coalesce(a1,0)+coalesce(a2,0)+coalesce(a3,0)+coalesce(a4,0), tools_rejected=coalesce(r1,0)+coalesce(r2,0)+coalesce(r3,0)+coalesce(r4,0) | eval reject_rate_pct=if((tools_accepted+tools_rejected)>0, round(100*tools_rejected/(tools_accepted+tools_rejected),1), 0) | where coalesce(sessions,0)>0 OR tools_accepted>0 OR coalesce(commits,0)>0 | sort - sessions | head 20 | table email, sessions, commits, pull_requests, loc_added, loc_removed, tools_accepted, tools_rejected, reject_rate_pct

panel.title: Connector Usage by User (Claude.ai, Cowork, Office Agent)

search.query: `claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_activity" (("$user$"="*") OR email="$user$") | `claude_latest_load` | stats sum('chat_metrics.connectors_used_count') AS chat sum('cowork_metrics.connectors_used_count') AS cowork sum('office_metrics.excel.connectors_used_count') AS o1 sum('office_metrics.outlook.connectors_used_count') AS o2 sum('office_metrics.powerpoint.connectors_used_count') AS o3 sum('office_metrics.word.connectors_used_count') AS o4 by email | eval office=coalesce(o1,0)+coalesce(o2,0)+coalesce(o3,0)+coalesce(o4,0), total=coalesce(chat,0)+coalesce(cowork,0)+office | where total>0 | sort - total | head 20 | table email, chat, cowork, office, total

panel.title: Selected User: Daily Activity by Product (messages and sessions)

search.query: `claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_activity" (("$user$"="*") OR email="$user$") | `claude_latest_load` | timechart span=1d sum('chat_metrics.message_count') AS "Claude.ai messages" sum('cowork_metrics.message_count') AS "Cowork messages" sum('cowork_metrics.distinct_session_count') AS "Cowork sessions" sum('claude_code_metrics.core_metrics.distinct_session_count') AS "Claude Code sessions"
